kdye01.title: The Out-of-Office Date
kdye01.caption: Can't switch off, even on your day off? Close the laptop and take yourself somewhere slow. Resting is a skill, and you're allowed to practise it.

kdye02.title: Party of One
kdye02.caption: Scared to eat alone in public? Nobody is staring. They're reading menus. Order exactly what you want and enjoy every bite.

kdye03.title: Phone in the Drawer
kdye03.caption: One hour, no phone, just you. The urge to check fades faster than you think, and your own thoughts turn out to be decent company.

kdye04.title: The Slow Lap
kdye04.caption: Rushing even on your day off? Walk slowly, sit for the sunrise, let the snail win. The point was never to finish first, just to be there.

kdye05.title: Nobody Else Gets a Vote
kdye05.caption: Always picking what everyone else would want? On a solo date there is one vote, and it's yours. Start with what you actually like.

kdye06.title: Stop Saving the Nice Plates
kdye06.caption: Saving the good plates for a special someone? You're already here. Make Tuesday the occasion and treat yourself like a guest worth fussing over.

kdye07.title: No Audience
kdye07.caption: Does it only count if someone sees it? Put the phone face down, dance in the kitchen, watch the sunset without filming it. Some moments are just for you.

kdye08.title: No Itinerary
kdye08.caption: Need a plan for everything? Try one afternoon with no list. Getting a little lost is how you find the bakery you never would have planned.

kdye09.title: The Back Row Matinee
kdye09.caption: Hate letting anyone see you feel things? Take yourself to a matinee and cry at the sad part. Feeling it all is allowed, and nobody keeps score.

kdye10.title: Tourist at Home
kdye10.caption: Waiting for the next big trip to feel alive? Ride three stops, find the mural you always walked past, try the food stall. Adventure starts close to home.

kdye11.title: The Class Alone
kdye11.caption: Skipping things because no friend can come? Take the class alone. The bowl might lean, and it will still be the one you made yourself.

kdye12.title: Be Your Own Crush
kdye12.caption: Lonely on a Friday night? Do what you'd do for a crush: candles, the good pasta, a sweet note. Then be the one who writes back to you.

kdye13.title: Cooking for Company
kdye13.caption: Cooking for one can feel a bit sad. Make the family recipe anyway, set the table properly, light the candle. You count as company.

kdye14.title: Wobble Proudly
kdye14.caption: Everyone at the rink seems to be in pairs this time of year. Go anyway. Wobble, fall a little, find your glide, then buy yourself the cocoa.

kdye15.title: The Free Show Upstairs
kdye15.caption: Swap the 2 a.m. scroll for the sky. On a clear winter evening, find Orion's belt and follow it to Aldebaran. The best show tonight is free and open to one.

kdye16.title: A Whole Saturday, Just Me
kdye16.caption: A to-do list with one item on it. Slow coffee, flowers, a nap with no guilt, then the last thing on the list. Rest counts as something you did. Save this for your next free Saturday.

kdye17.title: Solo Day Trip
kdye17.caption: Scared to go somewhere with nobody to talk to? Take the train anyway. Look, listen, let a stranger's dog say hi. Stay for the ending: the voice note goes to someone who deserves it.

kdye18.title: Beginner on Purpose
kdye18.caption: Hate being bad at things? Seven attempts, a lot of falling and one kind tip from a stranger. Being a beginner is where every good thing starts.

kdye19.title: The Unbirthday
kdye19.caption: Waiting for someone else to celebrate you? Bake the cake on a Tuesday, dance to your own playlist, and write yourself the card. You don't need a reason.

kdye20.title: The Evening Walk
kdye20.caption: Missing someone tonight? That's allowed. Take yourself for a walk, buy the cocoa, write everything down and keep it. The letter that matters most starts with dear me.
